data.name: Workflow4
data.value: Capture a field near the celestial pole

data.name: Workflow5
data.value: Rotate only the RA axis by 60–90°

data.name: Workflow6
data.value: Adjust the bolts until the markers overlap

data.name: Workflow8
data.value: Point near the celestial pole and capture the first reference. Plate solving uses the surrounding star pattern, rather than Polaris alone.

data.name: Workflow9
data.value: Keep altitude, azimuth and DEC fixed. Rotate RA only, let the mount settle, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Workflow10
data.value: Keep RA and the camera fixed. Adjust only the altitude and azimuth bolts in small steps, checking the next measurement.

data.name: MeasurementComplete
data.value: {0:HH:mm:ss} measured - adjust in small steps and check the next result.

data.name: Live0
data.value: Check the camera connection, observing site and plate solver settings.

data.name: Live1
data.value: References cleared. Capture the first reference again.

data.name: Live3
data.value: Capturing and solving the reference field -

data.name: Live4
data.value: Calibration complete. Start live adjustment, then adjust the altitude and azimuth bolts.

data.name: Live5
data.value: First reference solved. Rotate RA only, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Live6
data.value: Capturing and solving the next frame -

data.name: Live7
data.value: Measurement stopped. Resume or reset the references.

data.name: Live8
data.value: Measurement failed. Check the error and try again.

data.name: Field3
data.value: Reference image - start measurement to update guidance

data.name: View0
data.value: Resize the image and control panels

data.name: View4
data.value: Illustration only. Actual rotation is measured after capture.

data.name: View11
data.value: Directions describe telescope movement while facing the celestial pole, rather than which way to turn a bolt.

data.name: FocusTip
data.value: Zoom to the alignment markers. Turn off to fit the full image.

data.name: Details
data.value: Celestial Pole: target direction. RA Axis: measured rotation axis. Dashed rings show angular distance from the pole. Hardware accuracy has not yet been verified; atmospheric refraction is not applied.

data.name: StreamingMode
data.value: Native video - latest frame + plate solve

data.name: StreamingHint
data.value: Adjustment only; references use still captures. Live guidance uses registered stars; absolute solving verifies and restores tracking.

data.name: StreamingUnsupported
data.value: Requires a supported native QHY, ZWO ASI or ToupTek driver and readout mode. Other paths use repeated single frames.

data.name: StreamingStarting
data.value: Starting native video and plate solving...

data.name: StreamingEnded
data.value: Camera stream ended. Restart or select single frames.

data.name: FieldRecordHint
data.value: Records start with the first reference. Reset before changing this option. Images are saved for references and Mark only.

data.name: FieldNotesHint
data.value: Add a note before Mark or Stability, e.g. mount untouched, bolt adjustment, or independent comparison.

data.name: FieldMarkHint
data.value: Save the latest measured frame, RAW FITS when available, processed preview and note. Does not take a new exposure.

data.name: FieldRecordingReady
data.value: Field log starts with the first reference.

data.name: FieldScatter
data.value: Repeatability ({0} frames): Alt sigma {1:0.0} arcsec / Az sigma {2:0.0} arcsec. Not absolute accuracy.

data.name: FieldStabilityHint
data.value: Stability collects 20 new frames. Keep bolts, RA, DEC and camera fixed.

data.name: DebugHelp
data.value: Off by default. Applies to the next calibration (Reset first if needed). Records solved-frame data and saves RAW FITS for references and Mark samples in Local AppData/NINA/LivePolarAlignment/FieldSessions. Use Field validation in the imaging panel for Mark, Stability and Folder.

data.name: AutoRaClear
data.value: I checked the {0}-degree path is clear

data.name: AutoRaHint
data.value: Captures both references with the selected RA move between them. Keep Dec and bolts fixed. Direction follows NINA manual controls. Check cable, pier and mount limits first. No automatic return.

data.name: AutoRaUnsupported
data.value: Requires an idle, unparked equatorial mount with RA MoveAxis and tracking control. Manual rotation remains available.

data.name: AutoRaCheckPath
data.value: Automatic rotation is unavailable. Connect a supported mount or use manual rotation.

data.name: VerificationHint
data.value: Optional: capture a fresh rotation sequence to independently remeasure the axis after locking the bolts. This moves RA. Continuous fine adjustment already runs in live monitoring.

data.name: VerificationResult
data.value: Previous: {0:0.00} arcmin / remeasured: {1:0.00} arcmin. Difference Alt {2:+0.0;-0.0;0.0} arcsec / Az {3:+0.0;-0.0;0.0} arcsec. Keep the mount fixed.

data.name: VerificationComplete
data.value: Remeasurement complete. Review the differences and repeatability before adjusting further.

data.name: DriftFirstHint
data.value: Manually point within 25 deg of Dec 0 and within 15 deg of the meridian, above 25 deg altitude. Sidereal tracking ON; guiding, dithering and corrections OFF. Hold bolts and camera fixed. Records the selected duration (20+ solves). No automatic slew.

data.name: DriftSecondHint
data.value: Without adjusting bolts, manually point near Dec 0 with hour angle 45-75 deg east or west, altitude above 25 deg. Keep sidereal tracking on and all guiding off. Confirm again and record the second field within 30 minutes.

data.name: DriftConfirm
data.value: Guiding / corrections off; mount and bolts fixed

data.name: DriftReady
data.value: Two fields required. No independent result yet.

data.name: DriftFirstDone
data.value: First field stored: Dec drift {0:0.00} arcsec/min. Move manually to the second field.

data.name: DriftResult
data.value: Drift estimate {0:0} arcsec; guarded interval {1:0}-{2:0} arcsec. Shared solver and atmospheric systematics remain.

data.name: AssessmentPending
data.value: Independent verification pending. Target {0:0} arcsec. Available repeatability or remeasurement is not an accuracy certification.

data.name: AssessmentInconclusive
data.value: Inconclusive against {0:0} arcsec. Check pointing / tracking / seeing and repeat longer in steady conditions.

data.name: AssessmentRealign
data.value: Residual exceeds the {0:0} arcsec target. Recheck settings and realign, then repeat verification.

data.name: AssessmentInconsistent
data.value: Checks disagree. Check guiding, tracking, refraction and camera rigidity before realigning. Target {0:0} arcsec.

data.name: AssessmentWithinAvailableChecks
data.value: No excess detected against {0:0} arcsec in available checks. This is not an absolute-accuracy certification.

data.name: DriftPhaseComplete
data.value: Drift field complete. Review the independent verification panel.

data.name: DriftCompletedHint
data.value: Review the result and save the session folder. To realign, turn drift mode off, return manually near the celestial pole and capture new polar references. Nothing is slewed or adjusted automatically.

data.name: ManualRotateBrief
data.value: Rotate RA only by 60–90°, then capture the second reference. Keep Dec and bolts fixed.

data.name: AutoBrief
data.value: Start captures references and rotates RA automatically.

data.name: ManualBrief
data.value: Point near the celestial pole, then press Start. Rotate RA manually when prompted.

data.name: AdjustBrief
data.value: Use the altitude and azimuth bolts to bring the RA axis onto the celestial pole. Keep RA and camera fixed.

data.name: RotationDirectionHint
data.value: ON: counterclockwise command (NINA W / negative RA). OFF: clockwise (E / positive). The NINA primary-axis reversal option still applies.

data.name: ImpactCaveat
data.value: Unguided upper bound, not guiding RMS.

data.name: ImpactHint
data.value: Conservative upper bound from polar error and sidereal tracking. Actual motion depends on sky position. Guiding can correct drift; residual field rotation is separate. Seeing, periodic error, flexure and guider performance are not included.

data.name: ManualRotationRequired
data.value: Waiting for manual RA rotation. Rotate only RA by 60–90°, then press Capture rotated field. Live measurement starts after the second reference. For directory simulation, select the RA 90-degree image first.

data.name: CameraRequired
data.value: Connect a camera in N.I.N.A. Equipment before starting. Manual alignment does not require a mount connection.

data.name: ActionStopHint
data.value: Stop the current capture, RA rotation, or live measurement. Wait for cleanup before restarting.

data.name: AutoRaDisconnected
data.value: Connect a mount to enable automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaParked
data.value: Mount is parked. Unpark it in N.I.N.A. Equipment to enable automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaBusy
data.value: Mount is moving. Wait for it to stop before enabling automatic RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaNotEquatorial
data.value: The mount must be configured for equatorial alignment.

data.name: AutoRaAxisUnsupported
data.value: This driver does not support RA MoveAxis. Use manual RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaTrackingUnsupported
data.value: This driver cannot change tracking state. Use manual RA rotation.

data.name: AutoRaRateUnsupported
data.value: Select a driver-supported RA manual movement speed of at least 0.1 degree per second in N.I.N.A. mount controls, or use manual rotation.

data.name: AutoRaInvalidCoordinates
data.value: The mount returned invalid coordinates. Check its connection and configuration.

data.name: AutoRaDriverError
data.value: Could not read mount capabilities. Check the driver and connection.

data.name: AutoRaPreparing
data.value: Preparing automatic alignment — unparking and checking the mount…

data.name: AutoRaUnparkHint
data.value: Start will unpark the mount, verify readiness, then capture the references and rotate RA.

data.name: AutoRaReturnProgress
data.value: Returning RA to the starting position: {0:0.0}°

data.name: AutoRaReturnSolving
data.value: RA returned. Capturing and solving the adjustment reference…

data.name: FieldAlignInstruction
data.value: Bring the orange cross onto the green target

data.name: FieldMarkerLegend
data.value: Orange cross = RA axis · green target = celestial pole

data.value: {0} Make one small adjustment, release the bolt, then check the next measurement.

data.name: OperatorNextCalibrating
data.value: Measuring the axis. Keep altitude/azimuth fixed.

data.name: OperatorNextConnectCamera
data.value: Connect your camera in N.I.N.A. Equipment.

data.name: OperatorNextConnectMount
data.value: Connect the mount for automatic RA calibration, or select manual mode.

data.name: OperatorNextDrift
data.value: Follow the drift check instructions below and hold the mount fixed.

data.name: OperatorNextFailed
data.value: Keep the mount still. Check the error below before retrying.

data.name: OperatorNextManual
data.value: Rotate only RA by 60–90 degrees, then press Continue. Keep Dec and the adjustment bolts fixed.

data.name: OperatorNextPaused
data.value: Keep the mount still. Press Resume and wait for a fresh result before adjusting.

data.name: OperatorNextReady
data.value: Aim near the pole, then press Start.

data.name: OperatorNextReturning
data.value: Wait for the mount to stop and solve a fresh image before adjusting.

data.name: OperatorNextRotating
data.value: RA rotating. Keep the adjustment bolts fixed.

data.name: OperatorNextStale
data.value: Stop adjusting until a fresh result arrives. Displayed markers are from an older image.

data.name: OperatorNextStopping
data.value: Wait until camera capture and mount movement have stopped.

data.name: OperatorNextVerifying
data.value: Leave the adjustment bolts alone until remeasurement finishes.

data.name: OperatorNextWithin
data.value: Lock the bolts, then watch that the error stays within target.

data.name: OperatorFirstRaise
data.value: First, raise the polar axis slightly.

data.name: OperatorFirstLower
data.value: First, lower the polar axis slightly.

data.name: OperatorDirectionReference
data.value: Left/right: facing the visible celestial pole.

data.name: OperatorOutsideNext
data.value: {0} Use the location map and numerical errors to approach in small steps. If you cannot compare the markers, stop, reframe and Reset before recalibrating.

data.name: OperatorNextRecalibrate
data.value: Stop adjusting. The error exceeds 5 degrees or marker geometry is unavailable. Check the initial pointing and camera setup, then Reset and recalibrate.

data.name: OperatorFarNext
data.value: {0} The error is large: adjust one axis at a time and check a fresh result after every small turn. Bolt rotation amount cannot be inferred from sky error.

data.name: OperatorNextSolveFailed
data.value: Stop adjusting. Check that stars are visible, then check focus and exposure before retrying the plate solve.

data.name: TrackingActive
data.value: Tracking {0} stars · RMS {1:0.00} px · update {2:0.00} s

data.name: OperatorNextRecovering
data.value: The last measured image and markers stay fixed while a fresh measurement is acquired. Pause adjustment if this message persists.

data.name: TrackingRecovering
data.value: Live image · tracking unavailable · recovering with plate solving

data.name: TrackingHeld
data.value: Last measured image and markers held · waiting for a fresh measurement

data.name: PoleMasterInstructions
data.value: Select PoleMaster in NINA and aim near the celestial pole. Clear the 80° RA path, then press Start. Star centres and matching are automatic at three locations. After return, follow live guidance to adjust altitude and azimuth.

data.name: PoleMasterWrongCamera
data.value: PoleMaster mode requires a connected native QHY camera with a 1280×960 sensor. Select the PoleMaster in NINA, or turn this mode off for another camera. RA has not been requested by this check.

data.name: PoleMasterWrongField
data.value: The solution does not match a stock PoleMaster field near the visible celestial pole. Check the selected camera, stock lens, focus and pointing. Reset calibration.

data.name: PoleMasterStage
data.value: Reference fields: {0}/3 · star centres and field matching are automatic

data.name: PoleMasterConsistent
data.value: Three-location axis disagreement: {0:0.0}″ (consistency, not absolute accuracy)

data.name: PoleMasterInconsistent
data.value: Rotation-centre estimates disagree by {0:0.0} arcseconds (limit 60). Alignment stopped. Calculation inputs and failure details were written to the NINA log.

data.name: PolePreviewOff
data.value: Live preview stopped. Toggle PoleMaster off/on to restart.

data.name: PolePreviewWaiting
data.value: Connect PoleMaster in NINA. Preview starts automatically after connection.

data.name: PolePreviewStarting
data.value: Starting live preview… RA remains still.

data.name: PolePreviewLive
data.value: Live aiming preview · no solving or RA motion.

data.name: PolePreviewEnded
data.value: The camera stopped returning live preview frames.

data.name: OperatorNextPolePreview
data.value: Bring Polaris into view, then press Start.

data.name: StretchHint
data.value: Display only: left is darker, right is brighter. Raw pixels, star centres and solving are unchanged.

data.name: PoleMasterPatternInconsistent
data.value: The rotation model misses the middle-frame stars by {0:0.00} pixels (limit 1.5). Alignment stopped; images and calculation details are recorded.

data.name: RestartAxisFar
data.value: The computed rotation axis is too far from the pole to start adjustment. Three-position coordinates and failure details were written to the NINA log.

data.name: SkyPatternHelp
data.value: Start identifies the fixed Polaris star pattern automatically. Click Polaris only if automatic identification fails.

data.name: PoleMasterPatternStep
data.value: Matching surrounding star pattern {0}/3. Keep the adjustment bolts fixed.

data.name: RestartHomePlan
data.value: Stop capture → actual Home → start again. RA and DEC may move. Exposure and equipment gain are retained.

data.name: RestartHomingPlan
data.value: Moving to actual Home. Press Start after arrival to identify Polaris automatically.

data.name: RestartSelectPlan
data.value: Automatic identification failed. Click Polaris in the image, then press Start.

data.name: RestartReadyPlan
data.value: Start identifies Polaris automatically, measures two 40° RA intervals, then returns to the starting position.

data.name: RestartStepHoming
data.value: 1 / 3 · Homing · RA and DEC may move

data.name: RestartCurrentHelp
data.value: Discard all samples without moving the mount. Select Polaris again; Start will begin a new calibration from this pose.

data.name: RestartHomeUnsupported
data.value: The connected mount does not expose FindHome. Automatic restart is unavailable; check the mount connection and driver Home support.

data.name: RestartCoordinateError
data.value: The mount reported a coordinate change during rotation, so motion stopped. Home the mount and begin a fresh alignment.

data.value: Use the adjustment bolts to move Polaris into the green circle, then start fine monitoring.

data.name: MonitorLegend
data.value: Center the red cross in the green square using the adjustment bolts.

data.name: ManualPolarisVideo
data.value: Live camera · move Polaris into the green circle. Distance appears when Polaris is confirmed in the close-up.

data.name: CaptureSettingsLocked

data.name: CaptureSettingsBeforeStart
data.value: Set exposure before alignment. Set gain in NINA Equipment.

data.name: AdvancedSettingsHint
data.value: All capture exposures use milliseconds. Set gain in NINA Equipment.

data.name: PolarisAutoFailed

data.name: ReferenceMoveLegend

data.value: This pattern method requires a native QHY PoleMaster with its stock lens and 1280 × 960 sensor. Select NINA plate solving for the connected camera.

data.name: MethodPatternNeedsVideo
data.value: The selected driver/readout does not support PoleMaster live video. Check the native driver and readout mode, or choose NINA plate solving.
